title: finding(types): `tsconfig.test.json` closes with "Every test file in this package is compiled; keep it that way" — one file is not, by design, and the sentence ROTTED on a single identified commit
body:
Handed over by the dev of card objectui#9729 (PR objectui#9735) as an out-of-scope finding, and **re-derived before filing — which changed what it is.** Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01UanLVj6xvbS6puBCewLr8L`.

## ⛔ The hand-back's framing is corrected, not forwarded

It was handed over as a **type-check hole**: one test file in `packages/types` that no `tsc` invocation reads, described as the exact defect `tsconfig.test.json`'s own header says already happened once.

The mechanical half is right and reproduces exactly. **The diagnosis is not.** The exclusion is not a hole — it is a **construction with a stated reason and a cited card**, written down at `vitest.config.mts:206-214`:

> The `.dist.spec.tsx` suffix keeps these files out of `unit` (`*.test.ts`), `dom` (`*.test.tsx`) and `dom-heavy` (an explicit file list) BY CONSTRUCTION, so none of those three projects needed a single character changed. It also keeps them out of each package's `tsconfig.test.json`, whose include names `*.test.ts` / `*.test.tsx` — deliberately, because turbo's `type-check` waits on `^build` (the DEPENDENCIES' builds) and must never be handed a program that reads the package's own `dist` (objectui#4801 removed a self-referencing `paths` entry for that reason).

⇒ the file is **run** — by the opt-in `dist` vitest project, `DIST_PIN_GLOB = 'packages/*/src/**/*.dist.spec.tsx'` — and is **deliberately** not type-checked. ⛔ Widening either `include` would re-create the self-referencing program objectui#4801 removed.

## What IS wrong — one sentence, and it has ROTTED

`packages/types/tsconfig.test.json` closes with an invariant in the imperative:

> Every test file in this package is compiled; keep it that way.

That is **false today**, and it is false in the file that states it — so the next author to read it will either believe a hole is closed that is open, or will "fix" the carve-out that objectui#7183 built on purpose.

## ROTTED, not BORN FALSE — established at the write-time ref, with the falsifier pinned to one commit

The judgement is per SITE and the opposite repairs follow from it, so it is measured rather than asserted. Orphans = files under `packages/types/src/__tests__/` matching **neither** `src/**/*.test.ts` nor `src/**/*.test.tsx`:

| ref | date | what it is | orphans | **[LIT CTRL]** files IN the test project |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `c35fed098` | 2026-08-07 | **the sentence's write-time ref** (PR objectui#3574) | **0** | 28 |
| `dd5b01b59` | 2026-09-02 | `DIST_PIN_GLOB` / the `dist` project lands (PR objectui#7291) | — | — |
| `8195905bf` | 2026-09-09 | the commit immediately BEFORE the falsifier | **0** | 152 |
| `1ccfc235e` | 2026-09-09 | **the falsifier** — PR objectui#8646 adds the file | **1** | 153 |
| `20b5e361e` | today | `origin/main` | **1** | 203 |

The `include` line at the write-time ref is byte-for-byte the one in force today (`"include": ["src/**/*.test.ts", "src/**/*.test.tsx"]`), so the sentence did not drift by its own config moving — **the population moved under it**.

⇒ **TRUE when written, true for thirty-three days, falsified on 2026-09-09 by a single identified commit.** ⛔ Therefore it is NOT corrected outright: the ROTTED repair keeps the original, dates it, and names what falsified it. Overwriting it would erase that it was ever true — a false record of its own.

## The orphan, named

`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-subpath-single-module-8598.dist.spec.tsx` — **exactly one**, against a lit control of **203** files that ARE in the test project. 1 of 204, enumerated, not sampled.

## Class and size

Class **(b)** — it contradicts a contract declared in the tree, in the file that declares it. ⚠️ Class (b) by the letter, and **prose-sized** in the repair: the fix is to amend that sentence to name the `.dist.spec.tsx` carve-out, its reason (`^build` / objectui#4801) and its runner (the opt-in `dist` project), so the invariant states what is actually true. ⛔ No `include` changes, no tsconfig program changes, no test moves.

⚠️ Worth one check by whoever takes it, and ⛔ deliberately not done here because it widens the card: the same sentence-vs-population question exists in **every** package that has a `.dist.spec.tsx` pin and a `tsconfig.test.json`. This card names only `packages/types`. If the taker measures the others, that is a second card, not this one.

## Readings

All figures taken with `git fetch` first and every read against a `git` ref, ⛔ never the shared checkout's working tree. `origin/main` = `20b5e361e`, read at 2026-09-17T22:29Z.

Dedupe words: `Every test file in this package is compiled` · `dist.spec.tsx` · `DIST_PIN_GLOB` · `tsconfig.test.json include` · `zod-subpath-single-module-8598`
